summary: CI/toolchain issue, not compiler-verifiable. ASAN_OPTIONS=alloc_dealloc_mismatch=0 workaround from PR #5976 is still present unchanged in azure-pipelines.yml at 89e2f98e2. CI has since moved from OS-default clang to apt.llvm.org clang-18/libc++-18-dev on Ubuntu-24.04 (the originally-implicated package family), but the workaround was never re-tested against the new toolchain. Both upstream bugs cited by the reporter (llvm/llvm-project#59432, #52771) are now closed (2024-12-21, 2025-02-02 respectively), the latter specifically about apt.llvm.org libc++ -- suggestive but not proof the false positive is gone from DXC's current CI toolchain.
title: ASAN alloc_dealloc_mismatch false positive on Ubuntu Linux when using libc++ package
